items.title: World Modeling in Transformers
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.21748v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Behavioral failures can make a transformer appear to lack a world model even when it has learned faithful representations of its environment. We demonstrate this in TaxiGPT, a transformer trained on random walks through Manhattan whose failures have been interpreted as evidence of an incoherent internal map. Through mechanistic analysis and causal interventions, we show that the model represents intersections and streets, tracks its position, and uses a goal compass to navigate. We trace its failures to interference between superposed intersection features, which disrupts localization within the internal map. Affordance packing, which groups representations of intersections with the same legal moves, helps limit the consequences of these errors. items.summary_zh: 该论文探讨Transformer是否习得世界模型的问题。作者以TaxiGPT为例，该模型在曼哈顿随机游走数据上训练，其行为失败曾被解读为内部地图不一致。通过机制分析和因果干预，论文表明行为失败并不一定意味着模型缺乏忠实的环境表征，可能只是行为输出与内部表征之间的脱节。研究揭示了Transformer内部世界模型的表征与行为之间的复杂关系，对理解模型可解释性和泛化能力具有启发意义。

items.title: A Lie Detector Test for Language Models: Reading Knowledge a Model Won't Reveal
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.21996v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Large language models can hold knowledge they do not report. A model may sandbag on a capability evaluation, or answer against what it internally knows, and its outputs alone cannot tell whether it is hiding an answer or simply does not have one. We borrow the Concealed Information Test, a forensic method that identifies guilty knowledge by presenting a suspect with the true detail among plausible decoys and measuring a stronger response to the item they recognize. Our method, Probe of Internal Recognition (PIR), does the same inside a model. It presents a question with its candidate answers and reads, from the model's internal states, which candidate the model recognizes as correct. PIR is reference-free, needing no honest reference model and no labeled truth corpus. items.summary_zh: 论文关注语言模型可能持有但不愿报告的知识，例如在能力评估中故意放水或给出与内部认知相悖的答案，仅凭输出无法区分模型是隐藏答案还是根本不知道。作者借鉴法医心理学中的隐藏信息测试（Concealed Information Test），通过呈现特定刺激并观察模型内部反应来识别其是否掌握被隐瞒的信息。该方法为检测模型欺骗、评估诚实性以及理解模型内部知识与输出之间的差距提供了可操作的技术路径。

items.title: Information-Gain Rewards over Diversity-Pruned Tests: GT-Anchored Verifier Co-Training for Reliable Code Generation
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.21208v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Self-play methods that co-train a single language model as both coder and test author promise to move code-generation RL beyond fixed test suites, but they suffer from two coupled pathologies: permissiveness collapse, where pass-rate rewards are maximised by trivial, non-discriminative tests, and concentration bias, where i.i.d. sampled tests cluster on modal inputs and inflate estimator variance. We introduce CoVer (Co-trained Coder and Verifier), a single-policy GRPO framework that addresses both failure modes. items.reason_zh: 针对自博弈代码生成中测试宽松与集中偏差两大问题提出信息增益奖励与验证器协同训练，方法扎实。
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究代码生成强化学习中的自博弈方法，即让同一语言模型同时充当编码者与测试作者。作者指出这类方法存在两个相互关联的缺陷：一是“宽松性崩塌”，即通过率奖励会被琐碎、无区分度的测试刷高；二是“集中偏差”，即独立同分布采样的测试会聚集在相似模式上。为此，论文提出基于多样性剪枝测试的信息增益奖励，以及以真实测试为锚的验证器协同训练方法，以提升代码生成的可靠性。
items.title_zh: 多样性剪枝测试上的信息增益奖励：面向可靠代码生成的GT锚定验证器协同训练

items.title: Detecting Hallucination in LLMs: Tracing the Topological Signatures of Impaired Context Sharing
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.21096v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: In this work, we examine the topology of information flow patterns within attention graphs to effectively distinguish hallucinated from non-hallucinated responses. We analyze the Forman-Ricci curvature to identify structural patterns indicating information bottlenecks in attention graphs. We then introduce a method that captures both semi-local and global information-flow characteristics of attention heads associated with hallucinated responses. We evaluate our approach extensively across several LLMs and established benchmarks. Empirical results demonstrate that our proposed single-pass approach provides consistent improvements over existing attention-based and multi-response baselines across two hallucination-detection benchmarks, while achieving competitive performance across diverse LLM architectures. items.summary_zh: 该论文研究注意力图内信息流动模式的拓扑结构，以区分大模型的幻觉与非幻觉回答。作者分析 Forman-Ricci 曲率，识别注意力图中指示信息瓶颈的结构模式，并提出一种同时捕捉半局部与全局拓扑特征的方法。研究将幻觉问题与上下文共享受损联系起来，试图从信息流动的几何性质给出可解释的检测信号，为理解幻觉产生的内部机制提供了新视角。

items.title: Jev introduces a new shape of LLM - System One, aka Decision Models
items.raw_text:
Last week TypeSafe AI unveiled Jev, their first example of a new category of model that they are calling "System One models" (I'm with Maggie Appleton, I think "decision models" is a better name for these). Jev is an interesting variant on the usual LLM format: it still accepts text inputs, but instead of text output it returns floating point numbers corresponding to categories, yes/no questions, ratings, and associated confidence scores.

items.summary_zh: Simon Willison 撰文评述 TypeSafe AI 上周发布的 Jev，称其为一种全新类别的模型——“System One 模型”，并认同 Maggie Appleton 提出的“决策模型”这一更贴切的命名。文章介绍了 Jev 的定位：它不追求通用生成能力，而是针对特定决策任务做快速、确定性的输出，面向生产环境。Willison 分析了这类模型与传统 LLM 的区别，探讨了“决策模型”作为新范式的潜在价值与适用场景，并对其在 AI 生态中的位置提出了自己的观察与思考。

items.title: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
items.raw_text:
arXiv:2609.21841v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Frontier language models now produce professional deliverables that expert graders judge to match human work on a substantial share of economically valuable tasks, yet most enterprise GenAI initiatives fail to show a measurable business effect and a large fraction of agentic projects are expected to be cancelled. We argue that this is substantially a measurement problem: public benchmarks answer "what can the model do?", whereas a deployment decision requires "is this workflow fit, reliable, safe and worth scaling - here, on our data, under our controls?". We present EnterpriseVal, a use-case-level evaluation system that closes this gap. items.reason_zh: 量化企业生成式AI价值与可靠性，分析落地失败原因，对企业决策者有参考价值。
items.summary_zh: 该论文关注企业生成式AI的价值量化问题。尽管前沿语言模型在大量经济价值任务上已达到专家评分接近人类水平，但多数企业GenAI项目未能展现可衡量的业务效果，且相当比例的智能体项目预计将被取消。作者认为这一差距主要源于评估方法未能捕捉企业实际价值、可靠性和集成成本。论文提出EnterpriseVal框架，旨在量化生成式AI在企业中的效能、可靠性和价值，为企业决策者和研究者提供评估思路。

items.title: Jev: System One models for Prod, not God — with Diogo Almeida, CEO, TypeSafe AI
items.raw_text: The definitive Jev podcast with its lead creator.
items.reason_zh: Jev 主创深度访谈，阐述 System One 决策模型的设计理念与生产落地取舍，对理解新型模型范式有启发。
items.summary_zh: 这是 Latent Space 播客对 TypeSafe AI 创始人 Diogo Almeida 的专访，围绕其新发布的 Jev 模型展开。Jev 被定义为一种全新的“System One 模型”（又称决策模型），主打面向生产环境而非追求通用智能。访谈中 Almeida 解释了这类模型与传统 LLM 的差异：它不生成自由文本，而是针对特定决策任务做快速、确定性的输出，强调可靠性与可部署性。他还分享了 TypeSafe AI 在构建此类系统时的工程取舍、训练策略以及对未来模型形态的判断，认为生产级 AI 需要更窄、更专、更可控的模型，而非一味追求规模。
items.title_zh: Jev：面向生产而非“上帝”的 System One 模型——对话 TypeSafe AI CEO Diogo Almeida

items.title: Frontier Overhangs
items.raw_text: Pacing the frontier may be sincere, but it would also be strategically useful for the frontier labs to have time to reduce overhangs caused by model advancement.
items.reason_zh: Stratechery对前沿实验室“放缓节奏”策略的深度剖析，提出“overhang”概念，洞察独到。
items.summary_zh: 本文来自 Stratechery，探讨了前沿 AI 实验室“控制节奏”策略背后的动机。作者提出“Frontier Overhangs”概念，指模型能力进步与外部世界适应能力之间形成的落差。文章认为，放缓前沿推进虽然表面上是出于安全考虑，但对实验室而言也具有战略价值：争取时间减少因模型快速迭代而产生的“overhang”，即让社会、监管和产品生态跟上模型能力。文章分析了这种策略的合理性与潜在影响，提供了理解 AI 竞争格局的新视角。

items.title: Claude Code's cross-session messaging is a JSON file and a Unix socket
items.raw_text:
Claude Code sessions can message each other. It shipped in 2.1.224 and is properly documented, but it arrived as one changelog line with no announcement, so few people use it. I took it apart to put a Codex task on the other end.

Discovery is a directory. Each session writes ~/.claude/sessions/<pid>.json:

{ "pid": 58617, "cwd": "/Users/leon", "name": "leon-c0", "messagingSocketPath": "/tmp/cc-socks/58617.sock", "procStart": "Mon Sep 21 16:13:34 2026", "peerProtocol": 1, "status": "busy" }

ListAgents reads that folder. No daemon, no service.

Transport is one Unix socket per session, mode 0600, newline-delimited JSON:

{"msgV":1,"
items.reason_zh: 深入拆解Claude Code跨会话消息机制，揭示JSON文件与Unix socket的实现细节。
items.summary_zh: 作者深入拆解Claude Code的跨会话消息功能，该功能在2.1.224版本中悄然发布，仅有变更日志一行，鲜有人使用。文章揭示其实现机制：发现机制基于目录，每个会话写入JSON文件，并通过Unix socket进行通信。作者还尝试将Codex任务接入该消息系统。这是一篇对Claude Code内部架构的逆向工程分析，展示了其设计取舍。
items.title_zh: Claude Code的跨会话消息传递只是一个JSON文件和一个Unix socket

items.title: JEV 工程学：智能体系统的决策层
items.raw_text: 在智能体系统（Agentic Systems）构建中，让同一个大模型兼揽写作、推理、路由与决策，往往导致系统迟缓、昂贵且难以排障。本文系统拆解由 TypeSafe AI 提出的专用决策模型 Jev 及其工程方法论（Jev Engineering）：确立“大模型负责生成、Jev 负责决策、代码负责执行”的权责解耦哲学，通过 Choice、Score、Noul 三大类型化原语与置信度门控闭环，从根源上消除文本解析脆弱性。文章深入总结了 7 大工程法则、5 大常见反模式与 10 套高复用架构蓝图，为工业级 Agent 系统的低延迟、低成本与高可用落地提供了一整套严密的实战指南。
items.reason_zh: 系统拆解 Jev 决策层工程方法论，含 7 大法则、5 大反模式与 10 套架构蓝图，实战性强。
items.summary_zh: 本文系统拆解了由 TypeSafe AI 提出的专用决策模型 Jev 及其工程方法论（Jev Engineering）。文章主张在智能体系统中确立“大模型负责生成、Jev 负责决策、代码负责执行”的权责解耦哲学，避免让同一大模型兼揽写作、推理、路由与决策。通过 Choice、Score、Noul 三大类型化原语与置信度门控闭环，从根源消除文本解析脆弱性。文章还总结了 7 大工程法则、5 大常见反模式与 10 套高复用架构蓝图，为工业级 Agent 系统的低延迟、低成本落地提供实战指南。
